description: Log in with provider + ref using the atomic OAuth flow; awaiting-human state is returned in this call. After a dispatched timeout or error, completion may be unknown: retain session_id and call operate_observe before another action; do not repeat OAuth blindly. Drive the sealed username/password login lifecycle without exposing raw values. action='prepare_signup' seals the user's captured email and a generated password; 'store_signup' vaults those prepared slots with the same login-host safeguards; 'load_saved' fetches an allowed saved login through encrypted browser-fill and seals its fields into session slots. Use operate_type with slot to fill returned slots.

fields.description: Exact field_names from list_credentials for the selected reference. Defaults to ["login","password"] for logins saved by operate_login; use ["username","password"] when those are the stored names. Use operate_type with each returned slot to fill its matching form control.

name: operate_login
